verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official CLI (ldcli) for managing flags, account members, projects, environments, teams and other resources from the command line, and a probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. missing for 10: details on AI-native or agent-friendly CLI behavior (e.g. machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), installation and command depth, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: set up and manage your feature flags, account members, projects, environments, teams, and other resources directly from the command line.
